description: Apply-chain Lua firers: Lua-names fired from receiver apply helpers (depth >= 2) rather than from LuaActorImpl::vftable slot dispatchers. The Lua-name to opcode bridge merges this manifest as a third binding mechanism (alongside slot-based direct bindings and data-dependency indirect bindings).

firers.fireSite: FUN_006FAFF0 calls FUN_00447260("_onUpdateDisplayName", ...) + FUN_00CC7A90(...) on the new-name path
firers.bridgeStatus: PREVIOUSLY excluded from the bridge as a false-positive (see bridge-state.md). The receiver apply findings pass evidence places it in the SetDisplayNameReceiver (0x013D) apply chain at depth 2 - this is a CORRECT direct binding for 0x013D, not a false positive after all.

firers.bridgeStatus: NEW direct binding candidate: 0x0179 -> _onChangeSubStatStatus. Previously the bridge had no opcode binding for _onChangeSubStatStatus despite the name appearing in lua_api_index (LuaCallbackNameHarvest notes).

firers.fireSite: FUN_008A0370 calls FUN_00447260("_onReceiveTimingPacket", DAT_00f67298) + FUN_00CC7A90(param_2, local_60, local_a0) on the expired/zero-time path
